links.outcome: LLM accuracy on USMLE questions modified with cognitive-bias prompts versus unbiased baseline
links.effect: GPT-4 was resilient to bias, whereas Llama 2 70B-chat and PMC Llama 13B showed large drops in performance on biased questions.
links.quote: We assessed six LLMs on BiasMedQA and found that GPT-4 stood out for its resilience to bias, in contrast to Llama 2 70B-chat and PMC Llama 13B, which showed large drops in performance.

unlisted_practices: Prompt-based cognitive bias mitigation strategies (three strategies) for LLM medical question answering, which improved but did not fully restore accuracy

screen.reason: Evaluated the robustness of multiple LLMs to simulated cognitive bias in clinical question answering and tested three bias mitigation strategies.
